messages:
Maria: Heads-up — RC build hits cutoff in 2h. If you need a late merge, post justification + QA owner here :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: Need a late merge for a small emb-runtime bump (PR #5123). Tests green locally. @Jin can you do smoke?
Jin: I can smoke in ~30m. Is this a behavior change or packaging?
Sam: Packaging + tiny runtime tweak that fixes tokenization mismatch. Not a feature change but could affect some prod prompts.
Priya: Can you link the PR and explain why it can't wait post-freeze? We prefer to avoid late code merges unless blocking.
Sam: PR: <https://git.company/repo/pull/5123>. Causes rare tokenization diffs seen in staging logs; we saw a customer-facing flaky rerank in canary yesterday.
Alex: Quick note — if this affects tokenization we should be careful about backward compatibility of embeddings.
Priya: Okay — this looks like it qualifies as a late-merge if QA + oncall sign off. Requirements: QA owner, oncall ack, rollback plan, and changelog entry.
Deploy Bot: Release window closing in 1h (automated).
Jin: I'll take QA. Sam, please add a 1-paragraph smoke checklist and the rollback steps in the PR description.
Sam: Done — added checklist and rollback: `git checkout -b hotfix/emb-bump && git cherry-pick 1f2e3d4`; to roll back: `git revert -m 1 <merge_sha>` and redeploy previous tag.
Priya: Oncall: @Alex, any objection to merging if QA is green and metrics look fine during a short staging canary? We'll require a 15m canary and watch latency/kv-hit-rate.
Alex: No objection from me, please monitor KV cache and tokenization diff metric. Tag release-notes if merged.
Deploy Bot: Canary started for pr-5123 — dashboards: <https://dash.company/release/pr-5123-monitoring>.
Jin: QA: smoke + basic regression passed. No tokenization regressions observed in sample prompts. Load looks stable. Approving PR.
Priya: Good — merging now. Sam, keep rollback steps at the ready and post a follow-up in #incidents if anything odd pops. :thumbsup:
Sam: Merged, tagged as hotfix/emb-bump, and kicked the staging canary. Thanks everyone.
Priya: Noted — closing late-merge lane for this thread. If anything else crops up, open a new thread and mention release lead.
